content.snl: __list__(%An absent Entry Tag means no tag at all, and an Entry without tags stays valid forever.%(Concept.EntryTagOmission), %No reader or writer may eagerly rewrite an absent-tag Entry to add an empty array.%(Concept.EntryTagOmission), %When an update omits the field, the current tags are preserved rather than deleted; an explicit empty array is what clears them.%(Concept.EntryTagOmission))
